rv.q: John Doyle's inventive revival of Stephen Sondheim's 'Company' transforms the musical into a chamber piece of unusual intimacy and emotional depth.
Fire flickers, dangerous and beckoning, beneath the frost of John Doyle's elegant, unexpectedly stirring revival of "Company," which opened last night at the Theater.

"A year and a half later, the revival resurfaces as a rejuvenated triumph, mounted with insights both touching and stinging, and a canny understanding of the complicated mechanics of a show that takes place largely in the abstract.
